# nelson-modules-registry

Package registry for the Nelson Module Manager (nmm).

* `registry.json`: package index.
* `registry.json.sig`: Ed25519 signature of the index (generated by CI).
* `registry.json.sha256`: SHA-256 checksum of the index.
* `pubkey.ed25519`: public verification key.

To use this registry from Nelson:

```matlab
setenv('NELSON_NMM_REGISTRY', 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nelson-lang/nelson-modules-registry/master/registry.json');

nmm('search', 'keyword')
```

See `SECURITY.md` for the trust model.
